title: AIMPACT B2B Business Diagnosis Request
description: Versioned intake contract. Do not submit credentials, personal records, customer-level data, or confidential source files.

current_workflow.description: Q02: Current process steps from start to finish.

frequency_volume.description: Q03: Frequency and approximate weekly/monthly volume.

time_cost.description: Q04: Staff time, visible cost, and rework.

bottleneck.description: Q05: Greatest delay, error, or frustration.

systems.description: Q06: Software/system names or categories only; no credentials.

inputs_outputs.description: Q07: Information entering the process and expected output.

exceptions.description: Q08: Exceptions requiring judgment or human approval.

notes.description: Describe categories only; never include actual sensitive records.

data_sensitivity.description: Q09: Sensitivity screening; category-level answer only.

current_ai_use.description: Q10: AI tools currently used, if any.

success_measure.description: Q11: Pilot success criteria and measurable outcomes.

stakeholders.description: Q12: Process owner and pilot approver roles; avoid unnecessary personal data.

timing.description: Q13: Target date or operational deadline.

budget_range.description: Q14: Optional planning range; no commitment implied.
